key_insight: A hierarchy of rigid pendula with geometrically decreasing lengths and masses reproduces hallmark turbulence phenomena without fluid incompressibility or vortex dynamics.
engineering_relevance: Tunable mechanical or electrical realizations could provide controlled laboratory platforms for studying turbulent energy transfer and dissipation.
method: Construct a planar pendulum chain with geometrically decreasing lengths and masses.
Couple the hierarchy through nonlinear, nearest-neighbor rigid constraints.
Examine energy transfer, fluctuations, dissipation and thermal-noise amplification as viscosity decreases.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a statistically local, time-irreversible energy cascade, intermittent fluctuations, finite dissipation as viscosity vanishes and rapid amplification of small-scale thermal noise.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative benchmarks or experimental validation, so laboratory performance and robustness remain to be established.
